purpose: Complete public-data follow-up; user declined Synapse restricted data
candidates: All original 136 candidates retained; UKB23 frozen and AGES9 exposure-selected primary assays plus2 labelled secondary assays
AGES_selection: Maximum published exposure F per gene, ties by accession; selection already locked in AGES coverage before AD follow-up
primary_outcome: Bellenguez2022 GCST90027158 stage I, 21101114 variants, maximum N487511; excludes FinnGen stage II

cohort_evidence.statement: Stage I consortium list excludes FinnGen and CHARGE; FinnGen participates in stage II. Downloaded AD file exactly matches stage I variant count and sample count.

statistics: Wald first-order primary and second-order sensitivity; BH across all estimable primary assays within source and outcome; additionally joint UKB+AGES BH within each outcome; secondary assays separate
replication: Report same-direction FinnGen association and P; Bonferroni across discovery-significant protein-assay hypotheses, with all original candidates retained
variant_identity: Exact GRCh38 chromosome, coordinate and sequence allele pair, including merged/missing rs identifiers; ambiguous allele or duplicates excluded, no LD proxies
coloc: All AGES primary and secondary assays, both outcomes; complete unfiltered ±500kb regions; ABF single causal variant, p1=p2=1e-4, primary p12=1e-5 and sensitivity1e-6,1e-4; report continuous PP_H4; 0.8 descriptive strong-support cutoff
scale: Estimate quantitative sdY from SE, EAF, per-assay N using official coloc no-intercept regression; use prior SD0.15*sdY, outcome0.2; scale sensitivity0.5x/2x
unsupported: No brain-edge mediation, peripheral tissue specificity, drug efficacy, or full multicausal fine-mapping claim
UKB_regional: Not available: anonymous Synapse READ-only, user elected public sources only
